extracted.intended_audience: data scientists and practitioners performing self- and peer-review of data-science research and models prior to deployment
extracted.subtask_description: A practitioner's checklist for self- and peer-review of data-science work before deployment, covering dataset assumptions, preprocessing, leakage/bias, causality, metrics, overfitting, runtime, common bugs, and basic sanity checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dataset assumptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Validate sampling and dataset characteristics for production use, feature availability/consistency, shifts over time, limitations of the sampling procedure, and coverage of low-frequency phenomena.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sampling method validity for production; Feature availability and consistency; Dataset shifts over time; Sampling-procedure limitations; Low-frequency phenomena coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preprocessing
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure preprocessing is consistent, algorithms receive correctly normalized inputs, and scaling/parameters are fit appropriately to avoid introducing artifacts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistent procedures across train / test; Per-algorithm normalization; Parameters fit on training data only; Anomaly sensitivity in scaling methods; Delta-like distributions needing non-linear scaling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leakage and bias
rubrics_metrics.description: Detect and prevent leakage and dataset biases by checking indices, feature-importance anomalies, generation/collection consistency, experimenter effects, and segment differences between train/test.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index leakage; Feature-importance anomalies as leakage signal; Generated-data consistency across classes; Sample-collection consistency; Over-experimentation creating "leaderboard likelihood."; Train-test segment differences; Reasonableness checks on performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Causality
rubrics_metrics.description: Check that labels and features are causally and temporally appropriate—no future information leaking into training, and rolling/temporal model training is consistent with deployment timing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Label-timing alignment; Future information in training data; Forward-looking features (e.g., bi-directional moving averages); Rolling-model consistency during training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loss / metric
rubrics_metrics.description: Verify the loss function and evaluation metrics are correct, aligned, and meaningful for business objectives; ensure ensemble and custom-loss behaviors are appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Loss function correctness; Loss-metric alignment and monotonicity; Business-metric correspondence; Ensemble optimization validity; NN training behavior smoothness; Custom-loss anomaly sensitivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overfit detection
rubrics_metrics.description: Use robust checks to detect overfitting: random-seed sensitivity, consistent test sampling, cross-fold evaluation, proper hyperparameter tuning, and complexity analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Random-seed impact; Test-set sampling consistency; Multiple-fold evaluation; Hyperparameter tuning on train only; Complexity-parameter graphs; Parameter-reduction feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Runtime
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess runtime and operational constraints: feature computation costs, hardware assumptions, feature-reduction strategies, and whether ensemble gains justify added complexity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feature-reduction options; Feature computation time; Hardware assumptions; Ensemble-improvement quantification.

rubrics_metrics.name: "Stupid bugs"
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for common, simple implementation errors that break correctness: indexing, column/name mismatches, join/merge problems, versioned dictionaries, and incorrect weight files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index-column deletion; Column-name preservation; Label-feature index matching; Merge / join effects; Dictionary version control; Correct model-weight files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trivial questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Confirm basic sanity checks such as whether libraries behaved as expected, redundant features exist, and comparisons are made to simple non-ML baselines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Untested libraries due to technical issues; Redundant features; Non-ML intelligent benchmarks comparison.
